Aatrox.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Aatrox’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. If healing makes trades drag on, pick up Oblivion Orb next to apply Grievous Wounds, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford to delay a core item.
Aatrox.combo: Once Aatrox’s engage tool is down and you have a safe distance, slow him and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered basic attack and another basic attack. You can press Kayle E Starfire Spellblade right after a basic attack to bring forward the next one, and its empowered attack hits harder after the enemy has lost health.
Aatrox.escape: Aatrox using E Umbral Dash is your chance to close the distance. Go in only when you’ve avoided the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and aren’t caught by Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Aatrox.fight: Trade right after Aatrox uses the empowered basic attack from his P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, don’t take the duel; create distance and wait out its duration.
Aatrox.laning: Aatrox can easily follow up once he catches you, so give up dangerous CS. If he engages, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then use Kayle W Celestial Blessing to get away.
Aatrox.teamfight: Kayle doesn’t engage first. Stay behind your team and use your range to deal damage with basic attacks and waves of fire. If Aatrox is about to get on you and deal burst damage, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself to survive. Kayle R Divine Judgment blocks damage but not crowd control, so account for being pulled by Aatrox W Infernal Chains.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals significant damage and knocks you up, so when you see the cast animation, dodge outside or inside the blade’s sweet spot. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, use Kayle W Celestial Blessing for the movement speed before it pulls you in, then immediately leave the area.

Akali.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Akali deals mostly magic damage, and Kayle has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. Use the resistance reduction from Kayle Q Radiant Blast against Akali’s high magic resistance.
Akali.combo: After dodging Akali E Shuriken Flip, hit her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast to slow her and reduce her armor and magic resistance. Follow with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered basic attack and another basic attack.
Akali.escape: Dodge the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip, then go in when Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali R Perfect Execution are down. If Akali engages, retreat using the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Akali.fight: Fight aggressively after Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali R Perfect Execution are both down.
Akali.laning: If Akali engages, slow her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to create distance.
Akali.teamfight: Kayle doesn’t engage. Stay behind your team and use your increased range to land basic attacks. Decide in advance whether to use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself or on an ally who engages, in case Akali gets onto you. If you use it on yourself, cast it just before Akali’s burst damage lands.
Akali.watch: Dodging the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip is the most important thing. If it marks you, the second dash will follow even if you try to escape. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking. The second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution is more dangerous when health has been reduced, so use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before the burst damage lands.

Aurora.build: Aurora deals mostly magic damage, and Kayle has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. Build Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration is a problem, keep Grievous Wounds up with Oblivion Orb, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford to delay a core item.
Aurora.combo: When Aurora’s mobility ability is down, slow her and reduce her resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then follow with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered basic attack and another basic attack. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on missing health, so it’s better to use it after the enemy has lost health. If Aurora disappears with W Across the Veil, save your abilities until she reappears.
Aurora.escape: Don’t engage just because Aurora W Across the Veil is down. Your chance comes when Aurora E The Weirding is also down and before Aurora R Between Worlds is available again. Then slow her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and attack with your increased range.
Aurora.fight: If you’re hit by Aurora Q Twofold Hex while low on health, retreat instead of continuing the trade.
Aurora.laning: Give up dangerous CS. If Aurora engages, use Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing to get away.
Aurora.teamfight: Kayle should attack from behind with basic attacks. If Aurora jumps in, use the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to manage the distance. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before Aurora’s burst damage lands, accounting for the fact that invulnerability doesn’t block crowd control. If Aurora uses her jump to engage and doesn’t get a kill, that’s your chance to counterattack.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when the curse returns after its first hit, and the return damage increases as your health gets lower. If you’re cursed, leave the path between Aurora and yourself; if you’re below half health, retreat before it returns. Leaving the area after Aurora R Between Worlds appears slows you, so create distance before the zone forms.

Camille.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps. Camille deals mostly physical damage, so prioritize armor, but keep in mind that armor can’t reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol. If healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep is a problem, keep Grievous Wounds up with Oblivion Orb, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford to delay a core item.
Camille.combo: After the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses is gone, hit her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast to slow her and reduce her resistances. Follow with a basic attack, then immediately use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to bring forward the next empowered basic attack and continue attacking. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade gets stronger based on missing health, so use it after the enemy has lost health.
Camille.escape: Try a short trade when Camille E Hookshot is down and the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses is gone. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is still available, she can engage again, so don’t chase too far; look for an opening after Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is also down.
Camille.fight: Once Camille’s shield is gone and Camille E Hookshot is down, slow her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then trade with basic attacks.
Camille.laning: Position yourself so you can’t be pushed toward a wall. If Camille E Hookshot engages, use Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing to get away.
Camille.phase: Kayle is especially weak early, so focus on staying alive and gaining experience rather than fighting Camille.
Camille.teamfight: Kayle should deal damage from behind with basic attacks and waves of fire, using her range and watching for Camille E Hookshot’s engage. If Camille is about to get onto you and deal burst damage, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot comes in along a wall and stuns you, so stay away from walls. If you see her move in, slow her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then create distance with Kayle W Celestial Blessing. It’s hard to escape Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, so avoid her initial engage; if you’re trapped, use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before the damage lands.

Chogath.build: Cho’Gath mainly deals magic damage, and Kayle has low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. If healing from Cho’Gath P Carnivore is a problem, keep Grievous Wounds up with Oblivion Orb, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford to delay a core item.
Chogath.combo: After dodging Cho’Gath Q Rupture, hit him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast to slow him and reduce his resistances. Follow with a basic attack, then immediately use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to empower the next basic attack. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on missing health, so it’s better to use it after Cho’Gath has lost health.
Chogath.escape: Approach right after Cho’Gath Q Rupture is used on the wave or misses. If Cho’Gath W Feral Scream is also down, attack while he can’t silence you, slowing him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Cho’Gath has no mobility ability, but Kayle also has no ability to escape on her own, so keep your distance.
Chogath.fight: If you dodge Cho’Gath Q Rupture or Cho’Gath W Feral Scream is down, slow him and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then attack. If Cho’Gath catches you, use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before the burst damage lands, accounting for the fact that invulnerability doesn’t block crowd control.
Chogath.laning: Stand outside the line Cho’Gath attacks along so Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes can’t hit you through minions. If Cho’Gath approaches, escape using the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing, and give up dangerous CS.
Chogath.teamfight: Keep your distance to avoid Cho’Gath Q Rupture and Cho’Gath W Feral Scream. If you’re about to be caught and take damage, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself. You can also use Kayle R Divine Judgment on an ally when they engage.
Chogath.watch: When the warning appears under you for Cho’Gath Q Rupture, immediately sidestep to avoid the knock-up. If Cho’Gath W Feral Scream silences you, it’s difficult to respond to the Q that follows, so don’t start a trade from the front. If you’re at or below half health, create distance because of the true damage from Cho’Gath R Feast.

Darius.build: Darius’s main damage is physical, so build Cloth Armor first, choose Plated Steelcaps, and prioritize armor. Armor alone can’t stop the penetration from Darius E Apprehend or the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine, so don’t keep fighting while bleed stacks are building. If healing from Darius Q Decimate is a problem, keep Grievous Wounds up with Oblivion Orb, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford to delay a core item.
Darius.combo: After Darius E Apprehend is down, slow him and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then land a basic attack. Immediately use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade after the attack to bring forward the next empowered basic attack, then add more basic attacks while keeping your distance. End the trade before Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up.
Darius.escape: Move in for a short poke while Darius E Apprehend has missed or is down. The moment after Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions is also an opening, but stay out of the blade’s range. A fight is also less risky when Darius R Noxian Guillotine is down, but retreat immediately if bleed stacks build up.
Darius.fight: Avoid long trades where Darius P Hemorrhage can stack or Darius Q Decimate can heal him.
Darius.laning: If Darius approaches, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and get away using the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Darius.teamfight: If Darius E Apprehend catches you and his follow-up damage is about to land, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself to block the damage. Kayle R Divine Judgment doesn’t block crowd control, so account for the distance you’ll need to escape after invulnerability ends.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow up with Darius W Crippling Strike and Darius Q Decimate, so poke from outside E range. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade’s range to avoid its damage and healing. Create distance while Darius P Hemorrhage stacks are building, and fully disengage if you’re at a health level where Darius R Noxian Guillotine is threatening.

DrMundo.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Dr. Mundo’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. If healing makes duels drag on, keep Grievous Wounds up with Oblivion Orb, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford to delay a core item.
DrMundo.combo: Slow Dr. Mundo and reduce his armor and magic resistance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered basic attack and follow-up basic attacks. Using Kayle E Starfire Spellblade after Dr. Mundo has lost health adds damage based on his missing health. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, but Kayle Q Radiant Blast’s slow is not listed as an immobilizing effect, so don’t count on it to trigger the passive.
DrMundo.escape: If there’s a risk of being hit by Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw or he approaches, get away using the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
DrMundo.fight: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so when you have a safe angle to attack, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and follow with basic attacks.
DrMundo.laning: Keep a minion between you and Dr. Mundo to block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. If he approaches, create distance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If you’re below half health, prioritize staying under your turret over getting CS.
DrMundo.teamfight: If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, look for another advantage instead of spending time trying to kill him. Decide in advance whether to use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself when you’re caught, just before the damage lands, or on an ally when they engage.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target and hurts more when your current health is high, so dodge it with a minion between you and him. Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma mainly deals physical damage, so don’t take repeated hits at close range. While Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, account for its healing and movement speed increase instead of focusing on killing him.

Fiora.build: Fiora’s main damage is physical, and Kayle has low armor, so prioritize armor. Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If healing from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge is a problem in long fights, get healing reduction with Oblivion Orb, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford to delay a core item.
Fiora.combo: After Fiora W Riposte is down, slow her and reduce her resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Follow with a basic attack, then press Kayle E Starfire Spellblade during the attack’s recovery to quickly land an empowered basic attack. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on missing health, so use it after the enemy has lost health.
Fiora.escape: The moment after Fiora uses Q Lunge is a chance to close the distance, but save your key attacks if Fiora W Riposte is still available. Once Fiora W Riposte is also down, slow her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and attack briefly; don’t chase for long.
Fiora.fight: Don’t chase Fiora too far; use the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to keep your distance.
Fiora.laning: If Fiora comes in for a vital, slow her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use Kayle W Celestial Blessing to get away.
Fiora.teamfight: Kayle should deal damage from behind with basic attacks and waves of fire, and shouldn’t engage first. If you’re hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, stay against a wall so you don’t expose all four vitals. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before Fiora’s burst damage lands, or cast it on an ally who engages as their engage connects.
Fiora.watch: Fiora Q Lunge dashes toward a vital, so stand on the opposite side of it to limit her approach angle. Fiora W Riposte can negate Kayle Q Radiant Blast or an empowered basic attack and counterattack, so move sideways when using key abilities to avoid being hit by Riposte. If you’re hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, stay against a wall to block one side’s vital.

Gangplank.build: Build armor first with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps to withstand Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg. If healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is a problem in extended fights, buy Oblivion Orb to maintain Grievous Wounds, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can spare a core item slot.
Gangplank.combo: When Gangplank has just placed Gangplank E Powder Keg and there are no primed barrels nearby, trade in this order: Kayle Q Radiant Blast → Kayle E Starfire Spellblade empowered attack → basic attack. Apply the slow and resistance reduction from Kayle Q Radiant Blast first. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, keep attacking while he cannot remove the slow. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade grows stronger based on missing health, so it’s better to use it after lowering the target’s health.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no skill to create distance, so your chance to engage is when he has just placed Gangplank E Powder Keg and it is still unprimed, and Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is also down. Conversely, don’t engage if a primed barrel is nearby or you are in range to be slowed by E Powder Keg; use Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing to create distance.
Gangplank.fight: You have a chance to trade just after Gangplank places Gangplank E Powder Keg, while it is still unprimed; back off if there is a primed barrel nearby. After Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Since Gangplank has no skill to create distance, you can follow up with basic attacks.
Gangplank.laning: If Gangplank approaches or threatens you with a barrel, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to disengage. If you are below half health, prioritize staying deeper under your turret.
Gangplank.teamfight: Use your range to attack multiple enemies from behind with basic attacks and waves of fire. Avoid areas with primed Gangplank E Powder Kegs, and protect yourself or an engaging ally with Kayle R Divine Judgment just before damage from Gangplank R Cannon Barrage lands.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg deal mostly physical damage, and E Powder Keg also slows. Avoid E Powder Kegs that have been aging for a long time and spots where two barrels overlap, and destroy barrels yourself from a safe distance.

Garen.build: Buy Cloth Armor first, then choose Plated Steelcaps. Garen’s main damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment is physical, so build armor first. If healing from Garen P Perseverance becomes a problem, buy Oblivion Orb to maintain Grievous Wounds, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can spare a core item slot.
Garen.combo: After Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is spent and Garen W Courage’s brief shield window has passed, slow him and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Follow with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack and a basic attack, then create distance. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on missing health, so it gets stronger the more you weaken the target first.
Garen.fight: Don’t fight for long within range of Garen E Judgment, and delay your combo by half a beat just after Garen activates Garen W Courage.
Garen.laning: When Garen comes in, use Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing to disengage, and give up dangerous CS.
Garen.teamfight: If Garen gets close to Kayle, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and create distance with Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack applies silence and prevents Kayle from responding, so keep your distance while Garen has it available. Garen E Judgment deals continuous damage while he stays close, so slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to get out of its spin range. If you are below half health, stay out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health.
Garen.escape: Your window to engage Garen is right after he uses Garen Q Decisive Strike on a minion or consumes the empowered attack. Garen has no ability to create distance, but Kayle should trade briefly and back off so she doesn’t stay in Garen E Judgment for long.

Gnar.build: Hold on early with Cloth Armor, then choose Plated Steelcaps. Gnar’s main damage is physical, so build armor first, but remember that armor does not block the max-health-based damage from Gnar W Hyper / Wallop.
Gnar.combo: Apply a slow and reduce resistances first with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then hit Gnar with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade after he has lost health to make the most of its missing-health damage.
Gnar.escape: The moment after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down is your chance to close the distance.
Gnar.fight: If Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, or just after he changes from Mega to Mini, slow him and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast before attacking.
Gnar.laning: When Gnar approaches, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to disengage. Give up dangerous CS.
Gnar.teamfight: Stay in open areas away from walls so Gnar R GNAR! can’t knock you into one, and avoid fighting Mega Gnar head-on just after he transforms. Attack from behind and use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before heavy damage hits. Kayle R Divine Judgment blocks damage, but not stuns or knockbacks.
Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss’s boomerang can hit both on the way out and on the way back, so move out of its path. Create distance when Mega Gnar approaches, and don’t stand with your back to a wall where Gnar R GNAR! can knock you into it and stun you.

Gwen.build: Hold on early with Null-Magic Mantle, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Build magic resistance first against Gwen’s main damage, but dodge the true damage at the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by positioning, since resistances can’t block it. If healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts is a problem, buy Oblivion Orb to maintain Grievous Wounds, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can spare a core item slot.
Gwen.combo: When trading, slow Gwen and reduce her resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then attack with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack followed by a basic attack. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals extra damage based on the opponent’s missing health, so it’s better to use it after lowering Gwen’s health. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, don’t try to target her from outside the mist; wait for it to end.
Gwen.escape: The moment after you make Gwen use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is your window to close the distance. However, Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can come back quickly in a minion wave, so look for an opening where there are no minions. If you need to disengage when Gwen engages, use the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Gwen.fight: You have a chance to trade when Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down and Gwen W Hallowed Mist isn’t preventing your poke.
Gwen.laning: When Gwen comes in, slow her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to disengage. If you are below half health, prioritize your position deeper under the turret over CS.
Gwen.teamfight: Keep enough distance to avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! and watch out for the area damage from Gwen R Needlework. Just before Gwen gets close and deals heavy damage to Kayle, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself; if you need to save an ally’s engage, use it on that ally.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so when she uses it, walk to the side and get out of the center. While Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can’t target Gwen from outside the mist, so wait for it to end or enter the mist. Also watch out for the slow and max-health-based damage from Gwen R Needlework.

Illaoi.build: Illaoi’s main damage is physical, so hold on early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. To counter healing from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, buy Oblivion Orb first to maintain Grievous Wounds with Kayle’s sustained damage, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can spare a core item slot.
Illaoi.combo: When you have a window to trade, slow Illaoi and reduce her resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then basic attack and use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to bring forward your next empowered attack. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on missing health, so use it after lowering Illaoi’s health.
Illaoi.fight: When Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, retreat instead of standing your ground.
Illaoi.laning: Avoid tentacle areas near walls and stay outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range. When Illaoi comes in, slow her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to disengage.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t group where Illaoi R Leap of Faith can hit you. Move away from tentacles and draw her toward an area away from walls. Attack with basic attacks from behind, and use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before heavy damage hits you. If Illaoi’s ultimate is active, create distance with your team to wait out its brief damage window.
Illaoi.watch: Being hit by Illaoi E Test of Spirit exposes you to pressure from its slow and mark, so last-hit from outside its range and dodge it. Illaoi R Leap of Faith deals heavy damage in a short time, so move away from nearby tentacles when she uses it and avoid grouping with allies.
Illaoi.escape: Your window to start poking is right after you dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit and make her use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Even when that window opens, don’t go in deep near Illaoi’s tentacles or while Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active.

Irelia.build: Irelia’s damage is mostly physical and Kayle has low armor, so hold on first with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. If healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge becomes a problem, buy Oblivion Orb to maintain Grievous Wounds, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can spare a core item slot.
Irelia.combo: If Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia E Flawless Duet are down, slow her and reduce her resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then basic attack. Right after the basic attack, use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to empower your next attack, then follow up with another basic attack. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s extra damage based on missing health grows as you lower the target’s health first.
Irelia.escape: The moment after Irelia Q Bladesurge is down and the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down is your chance to close the distance and attack briefly. Conversely, don’t engage while Irelia can use Q to reach you through minions; if she engages, disengage with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Irelia.fight: If Irelia closes in again, slow her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to create distance.
Irelia.laning: If there is a low-health minion between Kayle and Irelia, Irelia can use Irelia Q Bladesurge to chain in, so take a step back.
Irelia.teamfight: Attack Irelia as your priority target with basic attacks from behind. Keep your distance, since Irelia R Vanguard's Edge’s slow and Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun can disrupt a teamfight. Just before Irelia gets close and deals heavy damage, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself, or cast it on an ally as they engage.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to reach Kayle, so create distance when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and if you are trapped inside the barrier from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Jax.build: The information alone isn’t enough to determine Kayle’s first purchase. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so don’t focus on just one type of resistance. Consider ways to reduce attack speed to deal with Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, slow him and reduce his armor and magic resistance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then land basic attacks. After a basic attack, use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to empower the next one and follow up. If Jax E Counter Strike becomes active again, stop attacking and create distance with Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Jax.escape: Right after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike and after Jax E Counter Strike ends are windows to trade while keeping your distance. If Jax approaches with Jax E Counter Strike active, move outside the stun range and attack once you’ve confirmed the ability has ended.
Jax.fight: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t trade with basic attacks; wait for its duration to end. After Jax E Counter Strike is down and Jax has also used Jax Q Leap Strike, Kayle has an opportunity to keep her distance and attack.
Jax.laning: When Jax approaches, disengage with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Give up dangerous CS.
Jax.teamfight: Attack from behind. If Jax engages with Jax E Counter Strike active, stop your basic attacks and move away from its area stun. After Jax E Counter Strike ends, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and keep attacking. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before Jax’s heavy damage lands, but account for the fact that invulnerability won’t prevent the stun.
Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, it negates Kayle’s basic attacks and Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack, so stop attacking and move outside the stun range. Jax can close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike, so when he jumps in, disengage with the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing.

Jayce.build: Hold on early with Null-Magic Mantle, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Build magic resistance first against Jayce, but magic resistance can’t block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast. Keep Jayce E Thundering Blow’s max-health-based damage in mind and use movement speed to dodge his attacks instead of stacking a lot of health.
Jayce.combo: When trading after dodging Jayce’s attacks, hit him first with Kayle Q Radiant Blast to slow him and reduce his resistances. Follow with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack and a basic attack. If you use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade after Jayce has lost health, its extra damage based on missing health will be greater.
Jayce.escape: The moment after you make Jayce use Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is your window to close the distance. If the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow is also down, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and try to engage. Don’t force your way in while both skills are available.
Jayce.fight: Right after Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is down, look for a chance to close the distance.
Jayce.laning: When Jayce holds the cannon, move side to side to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast. If he approaches, disengage with the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If you fall below half health, prioritize staying deeper under the turret over CS.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early and Kayle is weak, so stay alive while collecting experience and CS.
Jayce.teamfight: Kayle doesn’t engage first; deal damage from behind with basic attacks and waves of fire. Look for a chance to target Jayce the moment Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is down. Just before explosive damage hits you, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself; when saving an ally’s engage, use it on that ally.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce places Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so sidestep out of its line. When he holds the hammer, watch out for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow. Just before explosive damage hits, use Kayle R Divine Judgment to block the damage, but remember that invulnerability does not block crowd control.

Kennen.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Kennen’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Kennen.combo: When Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, hit him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast to slow him and reduce his resistances. Follow with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack and basic attacks. Using Kayle E Starfire Spellblade after Kennen has lost health deals more damage.
Kennen.escape: Engage after Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, as long as Kennen P Mark of the Storm isn’t one stack away from stunning you. If Kennen engages again or his mark stacks twice, stop chasing and create distance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Kennen.laning: If Kennen approaches or his mark has stacked twice, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and move away with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Kennen.phase: Kayle is weak early, so prioritize survival and experience over a few CS.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out from allies in anticipation of Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom’s engage, and attack from behind. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself or an ally who has engaged just before Kennen’s burst damage lands. Kayle R Divine Judgment’s damage immunity won’t prevent a stun, so watch Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stacks too.
Kennen.watch: Dodge Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, move away before the third hit. Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom can lead into an area stun, so don’t stand grouped with allies in the direction he’s engaging from.

Kled.build: Withstand the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Kled’s primary damage is physical and Kayle has low armor, so build armor first. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deals magic damage, which armor won’t block.
Kled.combo: When it’s safe to attack, slow Kled and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then follow with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack and basic attacks. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on the target’s missing health, so use it after lowering his health. Don’t extend the trade if Kled can close the gap again.
Kled.escape: Your opportunity to engage is after you avoid the pull from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and Kled E Jousting is down. If Kled has just used Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, check what dash options he has left before trading. Kayle has no mobility, so keep your distance while Kled still has an engage available.
Kled.fight: After Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and Kled E Jousting are down, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and land a short trade.
Kled.laning: Give up dangerous CS. When Kled engages, disengage with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Even after Kled is dismounted from Skaarl, he can build Courage and remount, so don’t overcommit to finishing him off.
Kled.teamfight: Deal damage from behind with basic attacks and waves of fire, and watch the flank from which Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is coming. If you have an allied tank in front, don’t let Kled’s charge disrupt your formation. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment to withstand Kled just before he reaches you and his heavy damage lands.
Kled.watch: If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and create distance with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing before he pulls you in. Don’t stay close enough to take Kled W Violent Tendencies’s fourth attack while it’s active. Watch for Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! to lead into an engage.

KSante.build: Hold on early with Cloth Armor, then choose Plated Steelcaps. K'Sante’s damage is mostly physical, so build armor first. If you’re repeatedly locked down by crowd control, you can also prioritize tenacity.
KSante.combo: After K'Sante’s engage tools are down, slow him and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then basic attack. Right after the basic attack, use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to bring forward your next attack, then keep basic attacking from a safe distance. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade is stronger after K'Sante has lost health.
KSante.escape: Try to trade after K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante E Footwork are down. If he has also used K'Sante R All Out, look for an opening before his engage tools come back, but create distance first if his pulling attack from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes is ready.
KSante.fight: When K'Sante R All Out is active, K'Sante becomes more vulnerable, but his damage and lifesteal also increase, so don’t take him on alone.
KSante.laning: When K'Sante comes in, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and create distance with Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Give up dangerous CS.
KSante.teamfight: Attack with basic attacks from behind while preparing for K'Sante’s engage. If he catches you, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before explosive damage hits, while accounting for the fact that invulnerability doesn’t block crowd control. When K'Sante R All Out is active and he becomes more vulnerable, focus your team’s damage on him. If the fight will be extended, make sure at least one teammate has a way to apply Grievous Wounds.
KSante.watch: Once K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes has stacked, his next attack pulls you in and stuns you, so watch his stacks and move out of range. When K'Sante W Path Maker is charged, sidestep the direction of the dash, and don’t stand with your back to a wall where K'Sante R All Out can knock you through terrain.

Malphite.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Malphite’s primary magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Malphite.combo: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then slow him and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Follow with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack and basic attacks. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade is more effective when used after the target has lost health.
Malphite.escape: If Malphite comes within range of Kayle Q Radiant Blast, slow him and disengage with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If you’ve been hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard, don’t start a trade. While Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, he has no way to dash in, giving Kayle an opportunity to poke again.
Malphite.fight: Don’t start a trade right after being hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard.
Malphite.laning: When Malphite approaches, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and disengage with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Prioritize staying alive to gain experience over a few CS.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t knock up several of you, and attack from behind. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before Malphite dives onto you and his burst damage lands. Kayle R Divine Judgment’s damage immunity won’t prevent a knock-up. Counterattack right after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down.
Malphite.watch: Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you, making it difficult to disengage if it hits, so don’t stay in its range for long.

Mordekaiser.build: Mordekaiser’s primary damage is magic and Kayle has low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If the healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible is a problem, use Oblivion Orb to maintain Grievous Wounds. Upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can spare a core item slot.
Mordekaiser.combo: Slow Mordekaiser and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then attack. Use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade when he has lost health. Finish the trade before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates.
Mordekaiser.escape: After Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp misses, you have an opportunity to attack while keeping your distance. Mordekaiser has no mobility, so you can create distance again with the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, though, don’t enter its range alone.
Mordekaiser.fight: Focus your damage after Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield has been depleted or converted into healing.
Mordekaiser.laning: You need to dodge Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, so don’t waste Kayle Q Radiant Blast on meaningless poke. If you’re at risk of being pulled, disengage with its slow and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If your health is below half, prioritize positioning inside your turret over CS.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Attack from behind while keeping your range, using basic attacks and waves of fire. Keep your distance from allies so Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp doesn’t pull several of you in, and don’t stand alone within range of Mordekaiser R Realm of Death if it’s ready. If you’re caught, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before taking heavy damage, while accounting for the fact that invulnerability won’t prevent crowd control.
Mordekaiser.watch: If you’re pulled by Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, you’re likely to take Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and basic attacks in quick succession, so keep your distance and avoid approaching from the front. Trade briefly and back off before you’re hit three times and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don’t enter its range alone and risk a duel where allies can’t help you.

Nasus.build: Withstand the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Nasus’s primary damage, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, is physical, and Kayle has low armor, so build armor first.
Nasus.combo: Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on the target’s missing health, so it hits harder after they’ve lost health.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no skill that lets him create distance on his own, so start poking once Nasus W Wither is down and Kayle can safely maintain her distance. Don’t engage alone while Nasus W Wither is available. When following up on a gank, use the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast.
Nasus.fight: Don’t continue a fight if Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active or if you’re within range of Nasus W Wither.
Nasus.laning: Don’t push the wave under Nasus’s turret, as that makes it easy for him to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. If Nasus engages, disengage with the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Nasus.phase: Kayle is weak early, so focus on staying alive and gaining experience rather than fighting Nasus.
Nasus.teamfight: Deal damage from behind while keeping your distance, using basic attacks and waves of fire. Don’t face Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active. Avoid positions where Nasus W Wither can catch you alone, and kite Nasus from behind your allies’ frontline. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment to block heavy damage just before it hits you, while accounting for the fact that invulnerability won’t prevent crowd control.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces movement speed and attack speed, disabling Kayle, who relies on basic attacks, so don’t move around alone within Nasus’s range. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands activates, avoid a direct fight and wait out its duration. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor, so leave the area it covers.

Olaf.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Olaf’s primary damage is physical, so build armor first, but remember that armor can’t reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, slow him and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then follow Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack with basic attacks. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on the target’s missing health, so use it after lowering his health.
Olaf.escape: While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, you can’t hold him in place with a slow, so keep your distance. Once it ends, hit him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast to trade.
Olaf.fight: Even when Olaf is low on health, his attack speed and lifesteal increase, so don’t risk closing in to finish him off.
Olaf.laning: When Olaf approaches, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and disengage with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Olaf.teamfight: If Olaf reaches Kayle, create distance with Kayle W Celestial Blessing and use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before his heavy damage lands. When Olaf R Ragnarok ends, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast.
Olaf.watch: Watch out for the slow and armor reduction from Olaf Q Undertow, and move opposite the direction where the axe lands to make it harder for him to retrieve it. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so don’t rely on armor alone when your health is low. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast won’t work, so create distance and avoid extending its duration by being hit by basic attacks or E.

Ornn.build: Kayle has no mobility and can easily be caught by Ornn’s crowd control, so consider tenacity before resistances. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so avoid building only one type of resistance.
Ornn.combo: When it’s safe to attack, slow Ornn and reduce his armor and magic resistance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then follow with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack and basic attacks. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on Ornn’s missing health, so it hits harder after he has lost health.
Ornn.escape: After Ornn E Searing Charge is down, you have an opportunity to close the gap and try to trade. However, Ornn R Call of the Forge God can catch you again if it’s still available, so look for an opening especially before that ability comes back up.
Ornn.laning: Staying alive and gaining experience takes priority over a few CS.
Ornn.teamfight: Attack from behind and use your range. Move out of the straight line between the elemental and Ornn when Ornn R Call of the Forge God is coming. If you’re caught, use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before Ornn’s heavy damage lands. Kayle R Divine Judgment blocks damage but not crowd control, so maintaining your position is key.
Ornn.watch: Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture’s pillar also counts as a wall, so keep away from the pillar and terrain walls. When you see Ornn E Searing Charge, move toward open ground to avoid the knock-up. If the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath hits and makes you Brittle, keep your distance to avoid follow-up damage and combos.

Pantheon.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pantheon deals mainly physical damage, and Kayle has low armor, so build armor first. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Pantheon.combo: When it’s safe to attack, slow Pantheon and reduce his armor and magic resistance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then follow up with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack and another basic attack. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade is stronger the lower the enemy’s health, so land it after your earlier attacks. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active toward you, wait for it to end or attack from the side.
Pantheon.escape: When Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, keep your range and look for trades while it’s difficult for him to re-engage with a stun. Check whether Pantheon R Grand Starfall is down too, and look for an opening before he can use it again.
Pantheon.fight: When Pantheon uses E Aegis Assault, stop attacking from the front and resume once it ends.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind minions against Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Pantheon approaches, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then use Kayle W Celestial Blessing to create distance.
Pantheon.teamfight: Attack from behind and make use of your range. Decide in advance whether to use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself or an ally who has engaged, in case Pantheon approaches. When you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, move out of range, then resume attacking.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so use Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s movement speed to stay outside its range. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the direction he faces, so don’t attack from the front; wait for it to end or attack from the side. When you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.

Poppy.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Poppy deals mainly physical damage, and Kayle has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Poppy.combo: When Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and you can keep your distance, slow her and reduce her armor and magic resistance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Follow with a basic attack, then immediately use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack. Add more basic attacks if it’s safe.
Poppy.laning: Avoid positions where Poppy E Heroic Charge can knock you into a wall, and give up dangerous last hits.
Poppy.teamfight: Attack from behind using your range, and avoid positions where Poppy E Heroic Charge can knock you into a wall. Move to the side when you see Poppy charging R Keeper’s Verdict. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before you take burst damage or when an ally who has engaged is about to take damage, accounting for the fact that invulnerability doesn’t prevent crowd control.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so stand in open space with no wall behind you. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, leave the area before the second hit detonates. If you see Poppy charging R Keeper’s Verdict, move to the side rather than staying in front of her.
Poppy.escape: Your chance to close the gap and attack is right after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. If Poppy starts charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, first move out of her path. Don’t continue attacking inside the zone from Poppy Q Hammer Shock.

Quinn.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Quinn’s physical damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots, and prioritize armor for resistances.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is down, slow her and reduce her armor and magic resistance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Follow with a basic attack, then use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade during the attack recovery to bring your next empowered attack forward, and continue with basic attacks.
Quinn.escape: The moment after Quinn E Vault is down is your chance to close the gap. Before then, Quinn can move back, so don’t try to engage alone. If Quinn E Vault’s forced movement puts you in danger, use Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing to create distance.
Quinn.fight: Start a fight with Kayle Q Radiant Blast to slow Quinn when Quinn E Vault is down or your jungler is nearby.
Quinn.laning: If Quinn P Harrier marks you, back away and farm when the mark is gone. If Quinn engages, slow her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s movement speed to get away.
Quinn.teamfight: If Quinn approaches from the side, slow her with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and keep your distance. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before burst damage hits, or on an ally when helping them engage.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, her empowered attack hurts, so move out of her basic attack range and let the mark expire. Avoid Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind a line of minions, and don’t force an engage while Quinn E Vault is available. If Quinn leaves lane with R Behind Enemy Lines, warn your team about the roam.
Quinn.phase: Quinn’s range and poke are threatening early, so Kayle should focus on staying alive and gaining experience.

Renekton.build: Renekton deals mainly physical damage, so start with Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. If Renekton Q Cull the Meek’s healing is a problem, maintain Grievous Wounds with Oblivion Orb; upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can spare a core item slot.
Renekton.combo: From a safe distance, slow Renekton and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then use a basic attack. Immediately after, use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to empower your next attack and follow with a basic attack. Using E after Renekton has lost health makes use of its damage based on his missing health.
Renekton.fight: Trade back when Renekton’s Fury is empty or after he has used Q, W, and E. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before burst damage hits.
Renekton.laning: Avoid standing in or behind a minion wave so Renekton can’t use the minions to engage with E Slice and Dice. If he engages, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s movement speed to retreat.
Renekton.teamfight: Don’t engage; deal damage from behind with basic attacks and waves of fire, making use of your range. If Renekton gets on top of you, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before burst damage hits. Since R’s invulnerability doesn’t block stuns, avoid positions where Renekton W Ruthless Predator can catch you.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is near or above half full, watch out for the stun from his empowered W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice unlocks a second dash when it hits a unit, so don’t stand in or behind a minion wave.
Renekton.escape: Your chance to close the gap is right after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. Try to trade when Renekton W Ruthless Predator’s stun is down and he has no Fury. If Renekton R Dominus is active, wait for its duration to end.

Riven.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Riven’s physical damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor. If Riven gets ahead, move defensive items earlier in your build.
Riven.combo: When it’s safe to attack, first slow Riven and reduce her armor and magic resistance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Follow with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack and a basic attack. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade gets stronger based on the enemy’s missing health, so it’s better to use it on Riven after she’s taken damage.
Riven.escape: The opportunity to engage comes after Riven uses Q Broken Wings to clear minions. Check whether Riven E Valor is down too before poking, and don’t go so deep that you enter range of Riven W Ki Burst or Riven Q Broken Wings’ knockup.
Riven.fight: If only Riven Q Broken Wings is down, she can still escape with Riven E Valor, so don’t rush to chase her.
Riven.laning: Give up last hits that put you within Riven’s reach, and stay under your turret if your health is below half.
Riven.teamfight: Attack from behind with basic attacks and watch Riven’s dash range. If she gets on top of you and is about to deal burst damage, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself, accounting for the fact that damage immunity doesn’t block knockups or stuns.
Riven.watch: Riven can close a long distance by chaining Q Broken Wings and E Valor, so back away as soon as you see her first dash. If you’re hit by the knockup from Riven Q Broken Wings or the stun from Riven W Ki Burst, she can easily follow with more attacks. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her range increases and her execute damage based on your missing health is dangerous, so keep your distance until it ends.

Rumble.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Rumble’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, then prioritize defensive items with magic resistance. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Rumble.combo: Once Rumble W Scrap Shield’s shield expires, hit him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast to slow him and reduce his resistances. Follow with a basic attack, then press Kayle E Starfire Spellblade during its recovery to bring your empowered attack forward. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on the target’s missing health, so it’s better to use it after they’ve taken damage.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so the time to attack is after he uses Rumble W Scrap Shield and its shield expires. If you’re hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, don’t go in; use Kayle W Celestial Blessing to create distance immediately. After dodging the second harpoon, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and keep your distance.
Rumble.fight: After Rumble W Scrap Shield’s shield expires, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and attack.
Rumble.laning: If Rumble walks toward you, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use Kayle W Celestial Blessing to get away. Prioritize staying alive and gaining experience over a few last hits.
Rumble.teamfight: Don’t stay where Rumble Q Flamespitter can reach you for long. If you’re hit by Rumble E Electro Harpoon, use Kayle W Celestial Blessing to reposition. Just before heavy damage hits, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself or time it on an ally who has engaged.
Rumble.watch: If you’re hit by both shots of Rumble E Electro Harpoon in a row, the slow becomes stronger and your magic resistance is reduced. Use Kayle W Celestial Blessing to create distance as soon as the first shot hits, avoiding the second shot and Rumble Q Flamespitter’s damage over time. Briefly wait after Rumble activates W Scrap Shield instead of piling attacks into the shield.

Sett.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Sett deals mainly physical damage, and Kayle has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Sett W Haymaker’s true damage in the center can’t be reduced by resistances, so dodge it with your positioning.
Sett.combo: When you can safely keep your distance from Sett, first hit him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast to slow him and reduce his resistances. Immediately after a basic attack, use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to bring your next attack forward and empower it. Continue with basic attacks if you can keep hitting him. Create distance before Sett W Haymaker gets stronger.
Sett.escape: When Sett E Facebreaker is down, the stun threat is lower and you have an opportunity to poke with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. If Sett approaches again, use Kayle W Celestial Blessing to create distance.
Sett.fight: After dealing damage, briefly back away in anticipation of Sett W Haymaker.
Sett.laning: If Sett engages, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s movement speed to get away.
Sett.teamfight: Deal damage from behind with basic attacks and waves of fire, and avoid positions where Sett can stun you with E Facebreaker by standing between you and minions or allies. When Sett grabs you to deal burst damage, use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before the damage hits. Kayle R Divine Judgment can’t break suppression, so time it carefully.
Sett.watch: Sett E Facebreaker stuns if there are enemies on both sides of him, so position yourself to avoid standing on the opposite side of Sett from a minion wave. Sett W Haymaker gets stronger based on the damage he takes, so create distance after dealing damage, and move to the side of the center of its aim when it activates. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it catches you, and Kayle R Divine Judgment’s damage immunity doesn’t block crowd control.

Shen.build: There’s no specific item listed for Kayle to buy first, so a purchase order can’t be set. Prioritize tenacity against the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash, and consider both physical and magic damage when building resistances. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Shen.combo: After Shen E Shadow Dash misses and Shen W Spirit’s Refuge ends, slow him and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Follow with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack and basic attacks. If Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is still active, wait to basic attack, but you can still use Kayle Q Radiant Blast.
Shen.fight: Keep your distance while Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, and resume basic attacks after it ends.
Shen.laning: If Shen engages, use Kayle Q Radiant Blast’s slow and Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s movement speed to get away. If Shen leaves lane with R Stand United, alert your team and take advantage of the empty lane.
Shen.teamfight: Attack from behind and keep your distance so Shen E Shadow Dash can’t catch you with its taunt. Stop basic attacking briefly when Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, then resume after it ends. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before you take heavy damage, remembering that damage immunity doesn’t block taunts.
Shen.watch: If you’re taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you’ll take empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so focus on dodging the dash. Also move out of the path of his spirit blade as it returns to him, and stop basic attacking when Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active.
Shen.escape: Your window to go in and counterattack is right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses. Check whether Shen W Spirit’s Refuge has ended, and account for the fact that Shen can escape if Shen R Stand United is still available.

Singed.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Singed’s main damage is magic, and Kayle has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Singed.combo: After Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are down, attack in this order: Kayle Q Radiant Blast → Kayle E Starfire Spellblade empowered attack → basic attack. Apply Kayle Q Radiant Blast’s slow and resistance reduction first, then land Kayle E Starfire Spellblade after Singed has lost some health.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so when Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are down, that’s your chance to engage. Slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and attack, but don’t chase all the way while walking through Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.fight: When Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are down, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and attack. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before Singed’s burst damage lands, but account for the fact that its invulnerability does not prevent roots.
Singed.laning: When Singed approaches, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and retreat with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Singed.teamfight: Kayle attacks Singed’s allies from the back line with basic attacks and fire waves, and doesn’t chase Singed all the way. If Singed dives in, use the time your allies’ crowd control buys to get away from Singed Q Poison Trail. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before you are caught and take damage, or just before damage lands on an ally who has engaged.
Singed.watch: Following Singed Q Poison Trail means you keep stepping in poison, so don’t chase even if he looks low unless you can finish him for sure. Go around areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive and keep your distance so Singed E Fling can’t fling and root you while you’re on it. If Singed is standing with his back to your allies, don’t stand where he can fling you behind him.

Sion.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Sion’s main damage is physical, so build armor first, but it’s important to dodge Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Sion.combo: If Sion is in range to hit, apply a slow and resistance reduction with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then follow with a Kayle E Starfire Spellblade empowered attack and a basic attack. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on missing health, so use it after Sion has lost some health.
Sion.escape: Your chance to attack comes after Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down and you’ve dodged Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Sion.fight: Use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before heavy damage lands, but account for the fact that it doesn’t block crowd control.
Sion.laning: Don’t waste Kayle Q Radiant Blast on meaningless poke if you need it to dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash or a jungler’s engage.
Sion.teamfight: Kayle attacks from the back line with basic attacks and sidesteps Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s straight-line engage. If you’re caught, use Kayle R Divine Judgment to block heavy damage. After Sion falls, reposition to avoid the revival attacks from Sion P Glory in Death.
Sion.watch: A fully charged Sion Q Decimating Smash knocks up and stuns, so move to the side when you see him charging it. Dodge Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught by sidestepping instead of running straight away or toward him. Sion E Roar of the Slayer slows you and reduces your armor, making follow-up attacks more dangerous.

Skarner.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads; build magic resistance first to prepare for damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. If you need a way to remove the suppression from Skarner R Impale, decide ahead of time whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build.
Skarner.combo: When Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down and you can keep your distance, attack in this order: Kayle Q Radiant Blast → E Starfire Spellblade empowered attack → basic attack. Apply Kayle Q Radiant Blast’s slow and armor and magic resistance reduction first, then deal Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s missing-health damage to Skarner after he has lost health.
Skarner.escape: Right after Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, Kayle has a chance to close the distance and attack. Kayle R Divine Judgment can’t remove the suppression from Skarner R Impale, so don’t force your way into range of R Impale.
Skarner.fight: After that dash is down, slow Skarner with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and attack with ranged basic attacks.
Skarner.laning: If Skarner engages, retreat with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing cast on yourself. If your health is below half, prioritize getting to a position inside your turret’s range.
Skarner.teamfight: Kayle deals damage from the back line while staying in range with basic attacks and fire waves, and avoids standing next to walls or at the edges of objective pits where Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact can easily reach her. Keep distance between Skarner and his allies so that Skarner R Impale can’t drag you deep toward them. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before heavy damage hits you, but account for the fact that it doesn’t prevent suppression itself.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact dashes through terrain and stuns if he hits a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. Skarner R Impale drags its suppressed target, and Kayle R Divine Judgment’s damage immunity doesn’t prevent suppression. When Skarner approaches, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and create distance with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing.

TahmKench.build: Tahm Kench’s main damage is magic, so first withstand it with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. If duels drag on because of healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin, pick up Oblivion Orb, and upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you have room to delay a core item.
TahmKench.combo: When you’re in range to fight, slow Tahm Kench and reduce his armor and magic resistance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Then use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade immediately after a basic attack to bring forward an empowered attack, and keep attacking. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on missing health, so use it after Tahm Kench has lost some health.
TahmKench.escape: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, there’s a window when it’s harder for him to engage or escape. Start attacking from Kayle’s increased range when Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has no stacks and you can stay out of range of Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash.
TahmKench.fight: Engage when you have an opening to commit to an all-in.
TahmKench.laning: When Tahm Kench approaches, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast that you’ve saved for escape, then create distance with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Prioritize avoiding death and losing experience, even if you have to give up dangerous CS.
TahmKench.watch: Watch out for the slow and stun from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, retreat and wait for the stacks to disappear. When you see the dive animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, move to avoid the area knock-up at its landing point.
TahmKench.teamfight: Kayle uses her range to attack from the back line, and spreads out from allies so several people aren’t caught by the area knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If Tahm Kench R Devour is available, account for it before committing finishing attacks to the target he is protecting. If Tahm Kench swallows an ally, focus fire on the slowed Tahm Kench. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment when you are caught and take burst damage.

Teemo.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Teemo’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, and prioritize magic resistance.
Teemo.combo: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, hit him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast to apply a slow and resistance reduction. Follow with a basic attack, then immediately use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to bring forward your next empowered attack. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on missing health, so use it after the opponent has lost some health.
Teemo.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. If Teemo W Move Quick is also down, he’ll have a harder time creating distance with movement speed, so use Kayle Q Radiant Blast’s slow and Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s movement speed to close the gap.
Teemo.fight: Try to trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Apply a slow and resistance reduction with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then follow with basic attacks and Kayle E Starfire Spellblade. Don’t start a fight centered on basic attacks while Teemo Q Blinding Dart is still available.
Teemo.laning: Don’t try to take CS while enduring the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot; give up dangerous last hits. When Teemo approaches, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and retreat with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Teemo.phase: Kayle is weak early, and Teemo’s blind and poison attacks are threatening, so prioritize survival and experience.
Teemo.teamfight: Kayle attacks from the back line and uses abilities or retreats instead of basic attacks while affected by Teemo Q Blinding Dart. Watch for Teemo R Noxious Trap near objectives and in narrow passages, and use Oracle Lens to check key routes. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment to block damage when you’re caught or when an ally’s engage is about to land.
Teemo.watch: If Teemo Q Blinding Dart hits you, your basic attacks are negated, so stop attacking during that time and use Kayle Q Radiant Blast or retreat. Teemo E Toxic Shot keeps dealing poison damage even after one basic attack, so stay out of range if you aren’t ready to fight. Be careful around bushes you have no vision of and chokepoints where Teemo R Noxious Trap may be.

Trundle.build: Trundle’s main damage is physical, and Kayle has low armor, so first withstand it with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. If healing from Trundle P King’s Tribute is a concern, use Oblivion Orb to maintain Grievous Wounds, and upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you have room to delay a core item.
Trundle.combo: Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on missing health, so it’s better to use it after Trundle has lost some health. Don’t follow him onto Trundle W Frozen Domain to land this combo.
Trundle.escape: When Trundle E Pillar of Ice appears, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, gain movement speed with Kayle W Celestial Blessing, and immediately sidestep. After Trundle E Pillar of Ice is past and you’re outside Trundle W Frozen Domain, use the fact that Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own and try to trade again in an open area.
Trundle.fight: Create distance when Trundle W Frozen Domain is placed or Trundle R Subjugate is active, and fight again after that window ends. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so take your chance in an open area after getting past Trundle E Pillar of Ice.
Trundle.laning: If Trundle gets on you, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and escape with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Trundle heals near the wave with Trundle P King’s Tribute, so don’t spend too long in lane while only chipping away at his health.
Trundle.teamfight: Kayle uses her range to deal damage from the back line with basic attacks and fire waves, and avoids Trundle W Frozen Domain and narrow paths where Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks the escape route. Don’t leave your frontline ally who was hit by Trundle R Subjugate to fight alone. Create distance or attack another target while Trundle is tanky. Use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before you’re caught and take heavy damage, or when an ally’s engage is about to land.
Trundle.watch: Trundle gains attack speed and movement speed inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, so don’t fight there; retreat outside it. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks escape routes in narrow paths, so fight in open areas. When the pillar appears, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and immediately sidestep. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, he steals resistances and becomes tankier, so create distance.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s damage is mainly physical, so build armor first. Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust is a concern, buy Oblivion Orb first, and upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you have room to delay a core item.
Tryndamere.combo: When Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, apply a slow and reduce his armor and magic resistance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then use a basic attack. Immediately after that attack, use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to empower your next basic attack, then keep attacking. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, create distance instead of committing your attacks, then attack again after it expires.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after Tryndamere uses his engage, Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, that’s your chance to attack while keeping your distance. Tryndamere W Mocking Shout slows opponents who turn away, so when retreating, walk backward while facing him and create distance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Tryndamere.fight: Use Kayle R Divine Judgment to absorb damage just before Tryndamere dives in and deals heavy damage.
Tryndamere.laning: If Tryndamere builds rage by attacking minions, retreat in advance. If he engages, escape with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Choose to avoid dying and losing experience, even if you miss a few CS.
Tryndamere.teamfight: If Tryndamere gets on Kayle, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before heavy damage lands. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, create distance to run out its duration. Add more teammates or trade for an objective instead of trying to hold the side lane alone.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere’s critical strikes are threatening when he builds Fury with Tryndamere P Battle Fury, and he can heal with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust, so back off when he starts building Fury by attacking minions. When Tryndamere charges in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, retreat with the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he cannot die, so create distance and attack after it expires.

Udyr.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Udyr’s damage is mainly physical, so build armor first. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle is a problem, use Oblivion Orb to maintain Grievous Wounds, and upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you have room to delay a core item.
Udyr.combo: After Udyr’s engage is down and his shield has worn off, apply a slow and resistance reduction with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Follow with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s empowered attack and a basic attack. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on the opponent’s missing health, so use it after chipping away at their health.
Udyr.escape: Right after Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, you have a chance to create distance or counterattack. If you’ve already been stunned once, Udyr can’t stun the same target again for a while; use Kayle Q Radiant Blast to slow Udyr and Kayle W Celestial Blessing to escape during that time. If Udyr has just activated Udyr E Blazing Stampede stance, watch out for the stun.
Udyr.laning: Place vision along Udyr’s gank routes and at jungle entrances, and don’t move forward in lane while Udyr is out of sight. If Udyr engages, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and escape with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Udyr.teamfight: Kayle attacks from the back line with basic attacks, and doesn’t try to burn down Udyr first when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. Clear the weaker enemies behind him first, then fight Udyr with your numbers advantage.
Udyr.watch: If Udyr runs in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stuns you, you’re likely to get hit by Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered basic attack and Udyr R Wingborne Storm too. Watch for the stun when Udyr has just activated Udyr E Blazing Stampede stance, and don’t move forward when Udyr is out of sight.

Urgot.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Urgot’s main damage is physical, and Kayle has low armor, so build armor first. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your max health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Urgot.combo: Once Urgot E Disdain is down and you have a safe distance, slow him and reduce his armor and magic resistance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Then land an empowered attack with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade and follow with attacks. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade gets stronger based on the target’s missing health, so it’s better to use it after they’ve already taken damage.
Urgot.escape: Engage only right after Urgot E Disdain is down, while he has no way to engage. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge is also down, the risk of being slowed and focused is lower. Don’t engage while taking both abilities; use the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to manage the distance.
Urgot.fight: Right after Urgot E Disdain is down, take the opportunity to close the gap and attack briefly.
Urgot.laning: Give up CS where Urgot can catch you, and use Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing to create distance when he comes in.
Urgot.teamfight: Position behind your frontline and attack while they take Urgot E Disdain first. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so standing behind your frontline reduces the chance of being caught. Just before you’re caught and take heavy damage, use Kayle R Divine Judgment to block the damage, but account for the fact that it won’t block crowd control.
Urgot.watch: If Urgot catches you with Urgot E Disdain, you’re likely to be stunned and hit by follow-up damage, so stay outside its engage range. Urgot Q Corrosive Charge heavily slows you and lets Urgot W Purge target you, so dodge it as it comes in. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get out of Urgot’s range before your health reaches the execute threshold.
