Volibear.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Volibear’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul is a problem, use Oblivion Orb to keep Grievous Wounds applied, and upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can spare a core item slot.
Volibear.combo: After Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, slow him and reduce his armor and magic resistance with Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Then, immediately after an attack, use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to bring forward your next empowered attack and keep attacking. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on the target’s missing health, so use it after Volibear has taken damage.
Volibear.escape: Wait out the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash outside his attack range, and engage only after confirming Volibear R Stormbringer is also down. If only Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, he can escape with his remaining dash, so don’t rush the chase. The window before Volibear R Stormbringer comes back is a better time to engage.
Volibear.fight: Volibear can heal with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, so unless you have a clear chance to finish him, don’t keep hitting him after he has lost health; back off. When Volibear’s mobility spell is down, slow him and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then attack.
Volibear.laning: When Volibear closes in, use Kayle Q Radiant Blast and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to create distance, and give up dangerous CS.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear has built up passive stacks by attacking minions or monsters, avoid fighting him while they’re active and wait for them to fall off. When Volibear’s charge catches you, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself just before the burst damage hits, but account for the fact that its invulnerability won’t prevent the stun.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash increases his movement speed as he closes in, then stuns with an empowered attack, so stay out of attack range and let it run out. When you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, sidestep to avoid the damage and slow. When your health is low, Volibear R Stormbringer can disable the turret briefly, so retreat deep under it.

Yasuo.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo’s main damage is physical, so build armor first.
Yasuo.combo: Use light poke to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first. When trading, slow him and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then land an empowered attack with Kayle E Starfire Spellblade followed by another attack. If Yasuo W Wind Wall makes it hard to use your key abilities, reposition or hold them until the wall disappears.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is a chance to engage. However, Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is a mobility ability with a short cooldown, so don’t chase deep just because he used it once. If Yasuo R Last Breath is unavailable, look for a play with your team’s crowd control.
Yasuo.laning: Minions give Yasuo E Sweeping Blade a path to approach, so keep the wave thin and give up dangerous CS.
Yasuo.teamfight: Just before Yasuo closes in to deal burst damage, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself to survive. Kayle R Divine Judgment blocks damage but not crowd control, so watch the timing of Yasuo’s knock-up as well.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo’s tornado knocks you up after he lands two consecutive hits with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, so when his stacks are full, watch for the sound and effect and sidestep. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him approach through minions, and he can follow a knock-up with Yasuo R Last Breath, so keep your distance.

Yone.build: Consider buying movement speed early to make it easier to get out of Yone’s telegraphed engage path. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on max health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Yone.combo: When it’s safe to attack, slow the target and reduce their resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then attack. Immediately after an attack, use Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to bring forward your next empowered attack. The more the target’s health is reduced, the more you can take advantage of its missing-health damage.
Yone.escape: After Yone’s tornado from Yone Q Mortal Steel disappears and Yone E Soul Unbound is down, Kayle has a window to step forward. If Yone R Fate Sealed is also down, trade within your range while checking what engage tools he has left. Don’t chase deep when only one of Yone’s mobility spells is down.
Yone.fight: If only Yone Q Mortal Steel is down, check whether Yone E Soul Unbound or Yone R Fate Sealed is still available before deciding to engage.
Yone.laning: When Yone prepares a tornado with Q, get out of range. If he comes in, use Kayle Q Radiant Blast and Kayle W Celestial Blessing to create distance.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, he’s preparing a tornado engage, so keep your distance until the stacks disappear. When he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast and retreat with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies it hits, so avoid its path. Even if you use Kayle R Divine Judgment just before the damage hits, account for the fact that it won’t prevent crowd control.
Yone.teamfight: Attack from behind, but watch your formation so you aren’t alone in the backline along Yone R Fate Sealed’s path. Keep your distance from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t hit several of you at once.

Yorick.build: Start with Cloth Armor and build armor first to prepare for Yorick’s main physical damage and the Mist Walkers’ attacks. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites is a problem, use Oblivion Orb to keep Grievous Wounds applied, and upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can spare a core item slot.
Yorick.combo: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, slow him and reduce his resistances with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then attack. During the attack recovery, press Kayle E Starfire Spellblade to bring forward your empowered attack, then keep attacking. The more Yorick’s health is reduced, the more missing-health damage Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals.
Yorick.escape: Yorick has no mobility, so dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist and waiting until Yorick W Dark Procession is down gives Kayle a chance to step forward. Slow him with Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then attack using your range. If you’re trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, break the wall first to escape.
Yorick.fight: Before fighting Yorick, clear out the Mist Walkers first. Target Yorick himself when the Maiden of the Mist is alone in a side lane.
Yorick.laning: If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, step forward to farm. When Yorick comes in, use the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to get away.
Yorick.teamfight: Use your range from behind to deal damage with attacks and fire waves. If Yorick’s Mist Walkers are on you, clear them out first, and keep your distance while dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist. Just before you’re caught and take heavy damage, use Kayle R Divine Judgment on yourself, but account for the fact that damage immunity won’t prevent crowd control.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and reduces your armor, so watch its trajectory and dodge it. If you’re trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, break the wall with attacks. When the Maiden of the Mist from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.
